atvPage.pricingBody: Rates are per ATV. Helmets, goggles, guide, on-site briefing, and free download photos are included on every tier.
atvPage.utvBody: Multi-passenger side-by-sides with the same guided safety cadence and complimentary photos — priced per vehicle, not per guest.
atvPage.nightGlowBody: Hit the trails after sunset on neon-lit ATVs, kitted out in glow gear, under a sky full of stars. It's the wildest after-dark ride in Miami — built for unforgettable memories and the kind of photos your feed deserves.
atvPage.galleryBody: A rotating look at ATV and UTV moments on the trail — swipe or pause to browse.

0.a: Every tour includes DOT-approved helmets, safety goggles, a trained guide, on-site safety training, and free action photos you can download after your ride.

1.q: Do I need experience to ride?
1.a: Nope. Riders of all experience levels are welcome. Your guide walks you through the controls, safety basics, and the trail before you set off.

2.a: Closed-toe shoes are recommended for the best grip and protection, but sandals are allowed.

3.a: Arrive 45 minutes before your tour start time. This gives us room for check-in, waivers, gear fitting, and a full safety briefing before you ride.

4.a: Cancel 5+ days in advance for a full refund. Rescheduling is free up to 24 hours before your tour. Within 24 hours, deposits are non-refundable but we'll do our best to move your booking.

5.a: Our ATVs support up to 400 lbs per machine. Our UTVs support up to 2,000 lbs total across all seats. If you have questions about fit, give us a call before booking.

6.a: Yes. Our Night Glow Tours run after sunset with neon-lit ATVs, glow gear, and pro night photos. Tours run as late as 1 AM, 7 nights a week.

atvPage.bookingHeadline: Lock in your ride with Blackline

bookingSteps.3: Bundle with the rest of your Miami itinerary
